status: development cases, frozen before the first pilot inference; not an unseen benchmark

questions.question: Compare conduction, convection and radiation. Give one everyday example of each and explain which can transfer heat through a vacuum.
questions.review: Distinguishes all three mechanisms; suitable examples; radiation can cross vacuum, material conduction/convection cannot; citations support the associated claims.

questions.question: How is a computer network different from the internet? Explain how computers can communicate locally when their internet connection is down.
questions.review: Distinguishes a local network from the internet; explains local connectivity without implying every service remains available; avoids invented infrastructure.

questions.question: Explain two ways agriculture changed human societies, and one disadvantage. Separate the changes from any claim that farming made every society better off.
questions.review: Specific supported changes and disadvantage; avoids universal progress or universal causal claims; retains historical qualifications.

questions.question: Using only these saved sources, what earthquake happened today and which roads are currently closed?
questions.review: Explicitly cannot establish today's events or road closures from saved reference material; no invented event, location or current access information.

method: Run identical questions with model-only and the pilot database, preserving raw responses, retrieved passages, hashes and timings. Review correctness, relevance, citation support, completeness and uncertainty separately. No automatic pass percentage.
